method: Independent code/source review and direct visual inspection of all nine final normalized PNGs after render-v4 completed. No source PDF text extraction; normal rendering and visual reading only.
scope: October2014 measured existing exterior in June2015 official report: original police office, later timber wing, later two-storey RC block and directly connected Residence A. Not a1931 reconstruction.

source_basis.reference_handling: Original reference photos and report renders are private and not included in this report.

front.png.finding: Whole connected complex complete; wooden gable joints now visible; two A102 windows have no invented upper transom.

rear.png.finding: Both staggered rear brick gables visible; later RC rear windows differ in width.

front_elevation.png.finding: Full height uncropped; entrance lower leaves no longer crossed by stone belt; unequal four-band narrow sash visible.

rear_elevation.png.finding: Rear filled tall openings retained, gable aperture and upper/lower RC windows preserved on distinct host planes.

left_elevation.png.finding: Blank timber gable retains horizontal joints; north corridor visible portion contiguous rather than dispersed; RC small upper rectangle neutral.

right_elevation.png.finding: Original side door belt interruption visible; Residence A altered window, high transom, narrow window and stepped service portal not mirrored.

top.png.finding: Stepped connected envelope and distinct flat/pitched/lean-to roof zones readable; no framing crop.

front_detail.png.finding: Paired main door, louvers, narrow four-band sashes, existing lamp and simplified foliage; no reconstructed missing badge.

rear_detail.png.finding: Filled old openings, small current windows and brick gable exteriors remain visible; roof no longer swallows rear-facing gable skins.

resolved_findings.result: Unsupported A102 transoms removed; neutral wall ornament remains.
Two-column narrow sash now has four unequal vertical bands; graphical height proxy disclosed.
North corridor four paired groups now placed contiguously using plan94/section105; two3x4 and two2x4 per-leaf groups, no mirror extrapolation.
Front and side plinth belts interrupted at original doors; lower panels exposed.
Rear and short-rear brick gable skins extend outward beyond roof ends; current small windows aligned to exterior.
Wooden wing horizontal-board triangular gable no longer swallowed by solid overhanging roof.

remaining_limitations: All graphical positions, sill estimates and simplified frames are proxies, not complete measured shop drawings.
A103 lower rear window is proven by plan/table/photo despite elevation occlusion; its sill remains a proxy.
Upper small RC rectangle remains unidentified and rendered as a blind plate, not guessed glazing.
Current altered and infilled openings are preserved; full original-state restoration is not claimed.
Opaque glazing and simplified lower panels do not establish interiors; whole model excludes separate B/C/D residences and neighbouring structures.
Tall rectangular feature function and depth are uncertain, explicitly nominal; no chimney interpretation.
Coarse masonry/tiles, foliage, finishes and frame thickness are display approximations; no physical trial-print or structural-safety approval.
